profile_meAttentionStreamChatMessageRequ.zh: 陌生人请求，{label} 条待处理

profile_screensAliasBlocked.en: That name has a word that isn't allowed. Try another.
profile_screensAliasBlocked.zh: 该名称包含不允许的词，请换一个再试。

profile_screensAliasReserved.en: That name is reserved by LOOP. Try another.
profile_screensAliasReserved.zh: 该名称属于 LOOP 保留词，请换一个再试。

profile_screensBootstrapRequired.en: Your account isn't set up yet. Try again later.
profile_screensBootstrapRequired.zh: 账号尚未完成初始化，请稍后重试。

profile_screensHint.en: 1–40 characters, doesn't have to be unique
profile_screensHint.zh: 1–40 个字符，可以和别人重复

profile_screensHint2.zh: 一句话介绍自己（可以不填）

profile_screensIdempotencyConflict.zh: 提交冲突，已重置，请再试一次。

profile_screensInvalidData.en: The service returned a profile that doesn't match the contract. Nothing was applied.
profile_screensInvalidData.zh: 服务返回的资料不符合约定，没有采纳任何内容。

profile_screensInvalidData2.en: The service returned privacy settings that don't match the contract. Nothing was applied.
profile_screensInvalidData2.zh: 服务返回的隐私设置不符合约定，没有采纳任何内容。

profile_screensLoopPreviewModeNoticeBody.en: {resource} is kept only in memory for this run. It isn't written to your account and calls no provider.
profile_screensLoopPreviewModeNoticeBody.zh: {resource}只保存在本次运行的内存里，不会写入账号，也不会调用任何 Provider。

profile_screensLoopSoftUpdatePromptBody.en: Update to the latest version. This version still works.
profile_screensLoopSoftUpdatePromptBody.zh: 建议更新到最新版本；当前版本仍然可以继续使用。

profile_screensLoopSoftUpdatePromptBody2.en: Update to {minimum} or later. This version still works.
profile_screensLoopSoftUpdatePromptBody2.zh: 建议更新到 {minimum} 或更高版本；当前版本仍然可以继续使用。

profile_screensMessage.en: Go back to Me and pick another setting.

profile_screensOffline.en: This device is offline. Your profile couldn't load, and no changes were submitted.
profile_screensOffline.zh: 设备当前离线，资料未能读取，也没有提交任何修改。

profile_screensOffline2.en: This device is offline. Privacy settings couldn't load, and no changes were submitted.
profile_screensOffline2.zh: 设备当前离线，隐私设置未能读取，也没有提交任何修改。

profile_screensPermissionDenied.en: Current policy doesn't allow reading or changing your profile. Nothing changed. This permission can't be changed in the app.
profile_screensPermissionDenied.zh: 当前策略不允许读取或修改账号资料，没有发生任何变化。这项权限不能在应用里自行调整。

profile_screensPermissionDenied2.en: Current policy doesn't allow reading or changing privacy settings. Nothing changed. This permission can't be changed in the app; the switches follow LOOP's records.
profile_screensPermissionDenied2.zh: 当前策略不允许读取或修改隐私设置，没有发生任何变化。这项权限不能在应用里自行调整；开关的当前状态以 LOOP 记录为准。

profile_screensPrivacyAnonymousModeSubti.en: Show only your alias, never your wallet address
profile_screensPrivacyAnonymousModeSubti.zh: 只显示别名，不显示钱包地址

profile_screensPrivacyConflictTitle.zh: 隐私设置已在别处修改

profile_screensPrivacyDiscoverableSubtit.en: Others can find you by nickname; your LOOP ID is always searchable exactly
profile_screensPrivacyDiscoverableSubtit.zh: 允许别人按昵称搜到你；LOOP ID 始终可被精确搜索

profile_screensPrivacyDiscoverableSubtit.en: Others can't find you by nickname; your LOOP ID is always searchable exactly
profile_screensPrivacyDiscoverableSubtit.zh: 别人无法按昵称搜到你；LOOP ID 始终可被精确搜索

profile_screensPrivacyEmptyTitle.zh: 还没有可展示的隐私设置

profile_screensPrivacyPermissionTitle.en: Privacy settings can't be read or changed in your region
profile_screensPrivacyPermissionTitle.zh: 当前地区不能读取或修改隐私设置

profile_screensPrivacyPermissionTitle2.en: This account can't read or change privacy settings
profile_screensPrivacyPermissionTitle2.zh: 当前账号无权读取或修改隐私设置

profile_screensPrivacyPublicHoldingsSubt.en: Others see your holdings and trades on your profile, never your wallet address
profile_screensPrivacyPublicHoldingsSubt.zh: 别人在你的主页能看到持仓和交易记录，不显示钱包地址

profile_screensPrivacyPublicHoldingsSubt.en: Only you can see your holdings and trades
profile_screensPrivacyPublicHoldingsSubt.zh: 只有你自己能看到持仓和交易记录

profile_screensPrivacySavePermissionTitl.en: Privacy settings can't be changed in your region
profile_screensPrivacySavePermissionTitl.zh: 当前地区不能修改隐私设置

profile_screensPrivacySavePermissionTitl.en: This account can't change privacy settings
profile_screensPrivacySavePermissionTitl.zh: 当前账号无权修改隐私设置

profile_screensPrivacyUnavailableTitle.en: Privacy settings aren't available right now

profile_screensPrivacyVisibilityNoteText.en: Visibility only affects what's shown. It doesn't let anyone copy your trades or access your wallet. Your avatar and username always show in chats and on your profile; your wallet address never appears on your profile.
profile_screensPrivacyVisibilityNoteText.zh: 可见性只影响展示，不会让别人复制你的交易或访问你的钱包；头像和用户名在聊天与主页上始终显示，钱包地址从不出现在主页上。

profile_screensProfileAvailabilityBanner.zh: 正在重新读取资料状态。

profile_screensProfileAvailabilityBanner.en: Can't read profile status right now

profile_screensProfileAvailabilityRetrya.en: You can keep browsing or retry now.
profile_screensProfileAvailabilityRetrya.zh: 你可以继续浏览，也可以现在重试。

profile_screensProfileEditOpenPrivacySub.en: Whether holdings and trades are public, who can add you
profile_screensProfileEditOpenPrivacySub.zh: 持仓与交易是否公开、谁能加你

profile_screensProfileEditPermissionTitl.en: Your profile can't be changed in your region
profile_screensProfileEditPermissionTitl.zh: 当前地区不能修改资料

profile_screensProfileEditPermissionTitl.en: This account can't change its profile
profile_screensProfileEditPermissionTitl.zh: 当前账号无权修改资料

profile_screensProfilePermissionTitle2.en: Your profile can't be read or changed in your region
profile_screensProfilePermissionTitle2.zh: 当前地区不能读取或修改资料

profile_screensProfilePermissionTitle3.en: This account can't read or change its profile
profile_screensProfilePermissionTitle3.zh: 当前账号无权读取或修改资料

profile_screensRegionBlocked.en: Your profile can't be read or changed in your region right now. Nothing changed. This isn't about your account; switching accounts won't change it.
profile_screensRegionBlocked.zh: 你所在的地区暂时不能读取或修改账号资料，没有发生任何变化。这与账号无关，换一个账号也不会改变结果。

profile_screensRegionBlocked2.en: Privacy settings can't be read or changed in your region right now. Nothing changed. This isn't about your account; switching accounts won't change it.
profile_screensRegionBlocked2.zh: 你所在的地区暂时不能读取或修改隐私设置，没有发生任何变化。这与账号无关，换一个账号也不会改变结果。

profile_screensS.en: Holdings and trades visible only to you
profile_screensS.zh: 持仓与交易仅自己可见

profile_screensS2.en: Strangers can't send you friend requests
profile_screensS2.zh: 陌生人无法向你发好友申请

profile_screensS3.en: When off, friends can't open a direct message with you either
profile_screensS3.zh: 关闭后，好友也无法打开与你的私聊

profile_screensS4.en: When off, friends can't add you to small groups
profile_screensS4.zh: 关闭后，好友无法把你拉进小群

profile_screensStepUpRequired.en: This step needs two-step verification, which isn't open yet. Nothing changed. Check Security Center for the verification methods available now.
profile_screensStepUpRequired.zh: 这一步需要二次验证，二次验证还没有开放，没有发生任何变化。请到安全中心查看当前可用的验证方式。

profile_screensStepUpRequired2.en: Changing privacy settings needs two-step verification, which isn't open yet. Nothing changed. Check Security Center for the verification methods available now.
profile_screensStepUpRequired2.zh: 修改隐私设置需要二次验证，二次验证还没有开放，没有发生任何变化。请到安全中心查看当前可用的验证方式。

profile_screensSwitch3.en: Anyone with your LOOP ID can add you
profile_screensSwitch3.zh: 知道你 LOOP ID 的人可以加你

profile_screensSwitch4.en: Friends can open a direct message with you
profile_screensSwitch4.zh: 已成为好友的人可以直接打开与你的私聊

profile_screensSwitch5.en: Friends can add you to small groups
profile_screensSwitch5.zh: 好友可以把你拉进小群

profile_screensUnavailable.en: The profile service isn't available right now. No changes were saved.
profile_screensUnavailable.zh: 资料服务当前不可用，没有任何修改被保存。

profile_screensUnavailable2.en: The privacy service isn't available right now. No changes were saved.
profile_screensUnavailable2.zh: 隐私服务当前不可用，没有任何修改被保存。

profile_screensUnexpected.en: The profile action didn't finish. Try again later.
profile_screensUnexpected.zh: 资料操作没有完成，请稍后再试。

profile_screensUnexpected2.en: The privacy action didn't finish. Try again later.
profile_screensUnexpected2.zh: 隐私操作没有完成，请稍后再试。

profile_screensValidationFailed.en: Alias or bio is too long. Edit it and try again.
profile_screensValidationFailed.zh: 别名或简介超出长度限制，请修改后重试。

profile_screensValidationFailed2.en: The submitted privacy settings weren't accepted. Check them and try again.
profile_screensValidationFailed2.zh: 提交的隐私设置不被接受，请检查后重试。

profile_screensValidationMessage.en: Alias must be 1–40 characters with no invisible characters.
profile_screensValidationMessage.zh: 别名需要 1–40 个字符，且不能包含不可见字符。

profile_screensValidationMessage2.en: Bio can be up to 160 characters.

profile_screensVersionConflict.en: Your profile was changed elsewhere. Reload before saving.
profile_screensVersionConflict.zh: 资料在别处已被修改。请重新载入后再保存。

profile_screensVersionConflict2.en: Privacy settings were changed elsewhere. Reload before saving.
profile_screensVersionConflict2.zh: 隐私设置在别处已被修改。请重新载入后再保存。

profile_signOutButtonLoopSignOutConfirmB.en: This device will stop getting notifications for this account, and the home screen data saved here will be cleared. Assets, friends and conversations in your account aren't affected; sign in again to get them back.
profile_signOutButtonLoopSignOutConfirmB.zh: 这台设备将不再收到这个账号的通知，本机保存的首屏数据会被清除。账号里的资产、好友与会话不受影响，重新登录即可恢复。
